acf.s079_p: Central Athens and the Port of Piraeus

acf.s088_p: Please contact IMM Group for the latest construction progress, availability, and project documents at the time of your consultation.
acf.s089_p: Greek real estate can be more than an asset that produces income and holds value in a foreign currency. Owning at Etolikou 11 also opens a route to residency in Europe (Golden Visa) for your whole family.
acf.s090_h2:
Your route to the
Greece Golden Visa
acf.s092_p: The project was created from a former industrial building that MIBS Group acquired and fully converted to residential use, in line with local government regulations.
acf.s094_p: The change-of-use model lets you qualify at the €250,000 Greece Golden Visa investment level that applies to this property category.
acf.s096_p: The permit runs for 5 years and is renewable in 5-year periods for as long as you continue to own the qualifying property.
acf.s097_p: The Golden Visa is a Greek residence permit, not EU citizenship; the right to live freely in other EU countries arises only once you naturalize.
acf.s099_p: Own an apartment at Etolikou 11 and open a route to a Greek residence permit for your whole family
acf.s102_h3: Visa-free travel in the Schengen Area
acf.s103_li: Travel within the Schengen Area without a visa, for up to 90 days in any 180-day period.
acf.s107_li: You can live, study, and do business in Greece with the rights of a residence permit holder.
acf.s111_li: You are not required to live in Greece to keep the permit
acf.s115_li: The permit runs for 5 years and is renewable in 5-year periods for as long as you continue to own the qualifying property.
acf.s118_p: Once you have completed the period of lawful residence that Greek law requires, you can look at the route to Greek citizenship.
acf.s120_p: Naturalization is a separate step, with its own conditions on physical residence, language, integration, and assessment.
acf.s122_p: EU citizenship rights, including the right to live and work in EU member states, arise only once naturalization succeeds.
